clogs.desc: These clogs make noise every time you take a step with them.

high boots.desc: These high boots come all the way to the hips.

heels.desc: Heels. They were commonly worn by sailors during the 16th century to observe the surroundings from a much higher altitude.

barbute helmet.desc: A redesigned medieval helmet made with steel. This is an incredibly rare and valuable item in these trying times, but it gets very hard to see in there.

motorcycle helmet.desc: A motorcycle helmet. Completely covers your head, but it affects your perception pretty heavily.

fire helmet.desc: A protective helmet used by firefighters that has a built in flashlight.

bike helmet.desc: A protective bike helmet used for riding bicycles safely.

baseball helmet.desc: A protective baseball helmet used to protect the user against fast flying balls.

survivor helmet.desc: Incredible helmet made by a very talented survivor. It is light, protective, durable, and fancy.

riot helmet.desc: It's one of those riot helmets used by the police. It protects the head completely, but is a bit cumbersome.

scale helmet.desc: A helmet made from some kind of chitin. You've never seen anything like this before the cataclysm.

scavenger helmet.desc: A jumbled mess of leather, plastic, and strings bound together by duct tape, strings, and other nonsense.

bucket helmet.desc: A metal bucket worn on your head. Very durable and protective, but it's quite cumbersome.

sparring helmet.desc: A sparring helmet typically worn for boxing.

leather helmet.desc: Some tough leather shaped into a helmet.

paper helmet.desc: Layers of paper were glued together into a protective head wrap that can protect you from scratches, but nothing more.

fur hat.desc: A fur hat made from once living animals. It is incredibly warm.

balaclava.desc: People wear this before doing very bad things.

bandana.desc: People wear this before doing bad things.

blindfold.desc: Wear this to block out sight completely. Maybe some day you might need this...

postman hat.desc: A hat worn by postman or postwoman. Blocks out the sunlight so you can see better.

boonie hat.desc: A boonie hat. Blocks out the sunlight so you can see better.

baseball cap.desc: A common cap. Blocks out the sunlight so you can see better.

hunting cap.desc: A common cap worn for hunting. Blocks out the sunlight so you can see better.

sunglasses.desc: These get in the way of your sight, but you will look way more charismatic.

hood.desc: A hood to hide your identity.

flower.desc: A flower behind your ears makes you look pretty.

zombie face.desc: A zombie mask to disguise your humanity.
